subject.title: [BUG] drive list/info ignore pagination; info falsely reports File not found past page 1

question: Should Feishu Drive `info` grow a folder-scoped lookup contract, such as an optional `folder_token` with paginated search, or remain root-only with users browsing via `list` first?
rationale: Current `main` can page folder listings, but `info` cannot be safely fixed by automatic root draining because the maintainer comment says Feishu bot credentials do not have a browsable root and the remaining repair would change the tool schema contract.

options.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
options.body: Expose a concrete folder scope for `info`, paginate that folder through `has_more`/`next_page_token`, and require focused regression plus gateway or live-compatible proof.

options.title: Keep info root-only
options.body: Leave `info` as documented root lookup behavior and update the issue/docs to steer users through `list` continuation instead of direct paginated search.

options.title: Design a broader Drive lookup API
options.body: Pause this narrow bug until a larger Feishu Drive search or lookup contract is defined across file types and folder scopes.

recommendation.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
recommendation.body: Expose a concrete folder scope for `info`, paginate that folder through `has_more`/`next_page_token`, and require focused regression plus gateway or live-compatible proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete landed the current list-pagination fix and left the explicit issue comment defining the remaining folder-aware contract concern.
